platform: Nintendo Switch (Definitive Edition) — with base Wii U (2014) and Wii U DLC content clearly labeled per finding

findings.name: Legend Mode — base Wii U scenario count
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game (2014, no DLC): Legend Mode consists of 18 story Scenarios (battles), organized into 7 episodes/arcs: Prologue (4 scenarios), Ocarina of Time (2), Twilight Princess (2), Skyward Sword (2), Epilogue (3), Ganondorf (3), Grand Finale (2). 4+2+2+2+3+3+2 = 18.
findings.trackable: Scenario select map shows cleared/uncleared status and a letter rank (C/B/A) earned per scenario, based on KOs, damage taken, and time.

findings.name: Legend Mode scenario-to-map list (base game, in story order)
findings.detail: LOW-MEDIUM confidence, sourced from a single fan walkthrough (paraphrased via AI fetch, not independently cross-verified line by line): 1. Hyrule Field — 'The Armies of Ruin' (boss: Volga/King Dodongo); 2. Eldin Caves; 3. Faron Woods — boss Gohma; 4. Valley of Seers — boss Manhandla; 5. Death Mountain; 6. Lake Hylia — boss King Dodongo; 7. Twilight Field; 8. Palace of Twilight — bosses Zant, Argorok; 9. Skyloft — boss Volga; 10. Sealed Grounds — boss Ghirahim; 11. Temple of the Sacred Sword — boss Wizzro; 12. Temple of Souls — 'A War of Spirit' (boss: Dark Link, confirmed independently as 2nd scenario of Epilogue arc, high confidence on this one specifically); 13. Valley of Seers — bosses Volga, Cia; 14. Gerudo Desert — boss Ganondorf; 15. Valley of Seers; 16. Hyrule Field — 'Battle of the Triforce'; 17. Gerudo Desert; 18. Ganon's Tower — 'Liberation of the Triforce' (final boss: Ganon). Individual scenario titles/order beyond 'The Armies of Ruin' and 'A War of Spirit' should be re-verified before building exact trophy text.

findings.name: King Dodongo
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. First Legend Mode boss, fought in scenario 'The Armies of Ruin' on Hyrule Field.

findings.name: Volga (Dragon Knight)
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Appears as an enemy captain/boss across multiple Legend Mode scenarios (introduced early, recurs through the story) before becoming a playable DLC-unlockable character via Cia's Tale (Master Quest Pack).

findings.name: Wizzro
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Boss enemy in Legend Mode; later playable via Cia's Tale (Master Quest Pack DLC).

findings.name: Ghirahim (Demon Lord)
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Boss encountered in the Skyward Sword episode of Legend Mode (Sealed Grounds).

findings.name: Zant (Usurper King)
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Boss in the Twilight Princess episode of Legend Mode, at Palace of Twilight.

findings.name: Argorok (Twilit Dragon)
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Giant boss in the Twilight Princess episode, Palace of Twilight.

findings.name: Gohma
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Giant boss in Faron Woods scenario, Ocarina of Time episode.

findings.name: Manhandla
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Giant boss fought at Valley of Seers.

findings.name: Dark Link
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Appears as the central mini-boss/enemy of the scenario 'A War of Spirit', the 2nd scenario of the Epilogue arc, set at Temple of Souls. Cia magically manifests Link's shadow as multiple Dark Link clones that must be defeated; Impa, Lana, Darunia, Midna, and Fi are present as allied support.

findings.name: Cia
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Main antagonist/sorceress; fought as a boss in the late Legend Mode (Ganondorf episode), before Ganondorf's return.

findings.name: Ganondorf / Ganon
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Final antagonist of the Grand Finale episode; fought first as Ganondorf, then transforms into beast form Ganon for the true final battle at Ganon's Tower, defeated with Zelda's Light Arrows.

findings.name: Helmaroc King
findings.detail: LEGENDS/DEFINITIVE-EDITION EXCLUSIVE. Giant boss appearing in the Wind Waker arc's Legend Mode scenarios 'A New Disturbance' and 'The Search for Cia'. Not present on Wii U in any form (base or DLC).
sources: community search summary, single-source — recommend re-verification

findings.name: Fi / Twinrova as Legend Mode bosses
findings.detail: Could not confirm whether Fi or Twinrova appear as fought bosses anywhere in Legend Mode (Fi appears as a support/ally character in 'A War of Spirit'). They may only appear in Adventure Mode content, or not as Legend Mode encounters at all in this game.

findings.name: Base game main antagonist and arc
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Ganondorf's spirit, splintered into fragments across time after an earlier defeat, manipulates the sorceress Cia (guardian of the Triforce's balance) by corrupting her infatuation with the 'Hero' archetype. Cia opens the Gate of Souls, pulling in eras/characters from Ocarina of Time, Twilight Princess, and Skyward Sword, and wages war using captains Volga and Wizzro. Link, Impa, and Lana each lead campaigns against Cia's forces. Ganondorf is ultimately resurrected as the true final threat.

findings.name: Base game ending
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Lana summons heroes from Hyrule's history; the combined force defeats Ghirahim and Zant en route to Ganon's Tower. Link defeats Ganondorf, who transforms into beast-form Ganon using the Triforce; Zelda's Light Arrows allow the final defeat and re-sealing of Ganon. The summoned past heroes return to their own eras, Lana takes over guarding the Triforce (Cia's former role), and Link and Zelda return the Master Sword to its pedestal.

findings.name: Adventure Mode unlock
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. The Adventure Mode map unlocks after completing the very first Legend Mode scenario ('The Armies of Ruin'), i.e., Adventure Mode does not require full Legend Mode completion to begin, only Legend Mode's opening battle.
findings.trackable: Mode selection screen shows Adventure Mode as unlocked/locked.
sources: community search summary — recommend re-verification against a primary walkthrough

findings.name: Hero Mode (New Game Plus-style difficulty)
findings.detail: BASE Wii U game. Hero Mode is unlocked after completing all 18 original Legend Mode scenarios. It is a harder difficulty option that can then be toggled on individual scenarios (Legend Mode scenarios replayed via Free Mode, and/or Adventure Mode battles), featuring tougher enemies and improved item drops. This is not a separate full story replay but a difficulty modifier applied per-battle.
findings.trackable: Difficulty toggle appears on scenario select screen once unlocked.
sources: community search summary of GameFAQs/Cheat Code Central — recommend re-verification

findings.name: Cia's Tale — Master Quest Map Pack (Wii U DLC #1, released October 2014)
findings.detail: WII U DLC — Master Quest Map Pack. Adds 5 new Legend Mode scenarios collectively titled 'Cia's Tale', playable as/alongside Cia, Wizzro, and Volga (who also become playable characters via this pack). The scenarios serve as a prequel/villain-perspective story showing how Cia built her army before her fall, leading into the events of the main 18-scenario story. This pack ALSO adds the 'Master Quest' remixed Adventure Mode map, Epona as a mountable weapon-type item, and costumes. Cia's Tale is DLC-only on Wii U (not part of base game), but is included in the base game of Hyrule Warriors Legends (3DS) and Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition (Switch) without needing separate purchase.
findings.trackable: Appears as its own arc on the Legend Mode scenario-select map once unlocked (DLC purchase on Wii U; automatically present on Legends/Definitive Edition).

findings.name: Twilight Princess Pack — no Legend Mode content (Wii U DLC #2, released November 2014)
findings.detail: WII U DLC — Twilight Princess Pack. Adds a new playable character (Twili Midna), a weapon, a Twilight-themed Adventure Mode map, and 2 costumes. Does NOT add any Legend Mode story scenarios — Adventure Mode content only.

findings.name: Majora's Mask Pack — no Legend Mode content (Wii U DLC #3, released early 2015)
findings.detail: WII U DLC — Majora's Mask Pack. Adds 2 new playable characters (including Young Link), a Termina-themed Adventure Mode map, and 3 costumes. Does NOT add any Legend Mode story scenarios — Adventure Mode content only.

findings.name: Linkle's Tale
findings.detail: LEGENDS/DEFINITIVE-EDITION EXCLUSIVE (introduced in Hyrule Warriors Legends on 3DS, 2016; carried into Switch Definitive Edition; NOT available on Wii U in any form, even with all 3 DLC packs). A 5-scenario side story arc following new character Linkle, a Cucco-farming Hylian girl who believes she is the reincarnated Hero. Scenarios unlock progressively, the first becoming available after clearing the base-game scenario 'The Sorceress of the Woods' (Faron Woods, Prologue arc).
findings.trackable: Its own arc/branch on the Legend Mode scenario-select map in Legends/Definitive Edition.

findings.name: Wind Waker arc
findings.detail: LEGENDS/DEFINITIVE-EDITION EXCLUSIVE (introduced in Hyrule Warriors Legends 3DS, carried into Switch Definitive Edition; NOT on Wii U). A 4-scenario arc introducing Wind Waker cast (Tetra, King Daphnes/King of Red Lions; Medli also unlockable by clearing an Adventure Mode battle rather than via DLC). Framed as an alternate sea-based Hyrule that briefly intertwines with the main story. Unlocks after completing the original 18 scenarios plus Cia's Tale and Linkle's Tale. Final scenario is 'Watchers of the Triforce', which is also the final scenario of Legend Mode overall in Legends/Definitive Edition. Comes bundled with the Great Sea Adventure Mode map.
findings.trackable: Its own arc/branch on the Legend Mode scenario-select map in Legends/Definitive Edition.
sources: community search summary — recommend re-verification of exact scenario titles beyond 'A New Disturbance' and 'Watchers of the Triforce'

findings.name: Legends/Definitive Edition total Legend Mode scenario count
findings.detail: LEGENDS/DEFINITIVE EDITION: total of 32 Legend Mode scenarios across 10 arcs = the 7 base arcs (18 scenarios: Prologue, Ocarina of Time, Twilight Princess, Skyward Sword, Epilogue, Ganondorf, Grand Finale) + Cia's Tale (5) + Linkle's Tale (5) + Wind Waker arc (4). Math is internally consistent (18+5+5+4=32) across independently found sub-counts.

versionNotes.note: Base Wii U Legend Mode (no DLC) = 18 scenarios / 7 arcs only.

Wii U + all 3 DLC packs = 23 Legend Mode scenarios (18 base + 5 Cia's Tale from Master Quest Map Pack). Twilight Princess Pack and Majora's Mask Pack add zero Legend Mode scenarios — Adventure Mode content only.

Hyrule Warriors Legends (3DS, 2016) and Hyrule Warriors: Definitive Edition (Switch, 2018) ship all of the above as base content (no purchase needed) PLUS two Legends-exclusive additions never available on Wii U in any form: Linkle's Tale (5 scenarios) and the Wind Waker arc (4 scenarios). Total = 32 scenarios / 10 arcs.

Cia's Tale is NOT a Legends-exclusive feature as might be assumed from its 'prequel/retelling' framing — it originated as paid Wii U DLC (Master Quest Map Pack) and was later folded into Legends/Definitive Edition as free base content. This is a common point of confusion worth flagging explicitly.
